stats.label: On the decks and the mic

bio.short: DJ Play (Dawaun Lucas) is an open format DJ and MC from Compton, mixing since 2008. Hip-hop, funk, R&B and today's hits for weddings, parties, church and corporate events across Southern California.
long: DJ Play is Dawaun Lucas, a DJ and MC from Compton who has been mixing since 2008. He's open format, so a set can move from golden-era hip-hop to the funk that came before it, then through R&B, throwbacks and today's hits. Every generation in the room hears a song they know.
He works the mic as well as the decks. That means smooth transitions, a dance floor that stays full, and an MC who keeps the night moving and on schedule.

For more than 15 years he has played private parties, weddings, church celebrations, corporate events and community gatherings across Los Angeles. Send your must-play and do-not-play lists ahead of time, and he keeps it clean for church and family events.

packages_intro: Every package includes up to 5 hours, professional setup, transport and breakdown, plus a pre-event consultation.
packages_note: Prices are starting rates. Travel fees may apply depending on location. Wedding packages available on request.

faq.a: Every package includes professional sound, setup, transport and breakdown, plus a pre-event consultation to plan the music and the timeline. Mics, lighting and MC vary by package.
Yes. DJ Play covers all of Los Angeles County, Orange County and beyond. Travel fees may apply depending on location, and your quote has no hidden costs.
Yes. Send your must-play and do-not-play lists before the event. Guests can also send requests live from their phones.

faq.q: Can you keep the music clean?
faq.a: Yes. Music stays clean and family-friendly for church and family events.

faq.q: What if something goes wrong with the equipment?
faq.a: DJ Play arrives with professional-grade sound and always brings backup gear.

faq.q: How far ahead should I book?
faq.a: 4 to 6 weeks ahead is best. Last-minute dates are sometimes available, so ask.

faq.q: How do I lock in my date?
faq.a: Send an inquiry and you'll hear back within 24 hours. A signed contract and deposit secure the date.
